about_the_game: Step into a chaotic 3D playground where memes come to life! In this wacky physics-based merging game, your goal is simple: **drop objects, merge them into bigger and funnier forms, and survive the madness inside the box**. From ninja coffee cups to rolling watermelons and totally unexpected creatures, every drop brings you closer to hilarious disaster. ⚡ **Easy to play, hard to master** – Just drop and watch the physics do their job… until the box fills up and chaos takes over. 🤣 **Meme-fueled mayhem** – Each merge creates something stranger, funnier, and more unpredictable than before. 🎲 **Endless replayability** – No two runs are the same. Experiment with angles, timing, and strategy to beat your high score. 🎨 **Full 3D twist** – Unlike other merge games, here you can rotate, zoom, and fully experience the action in three dimensions. Are you ready to embrace the brainrot? Climb the leaderboard, discover absurd combinations, and lose yourself in the most ridiculous merging experience ever.
